description_en: Deletes the marks of a media asset
name: DeleteMediaMarks

parameters.description_en: The ID of the media asset.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.description_en:
The mark ID. You can specify multiple mark IDs separated with commas (,).

If you do not specify MediaMarkIds, all the marks of the media asset are deleted.
parameters.description_zh:
标记ID，支持多值，多值以逗号分隔。

如果 MediaMarkIds 为空，默认删除媒资所有的点位信息。
